subject: 41 Mystic Avenue Preservation Efforts
overview: The commission discussed historic district signage projects and homeowner outreach initiatives. The meeting's primary focus was exploring preservation and relocation alternatives for a 1750 house at 41 Mystic Avenue currently facing demolition.

items.title: South Street District Signage
items.summary: The commission identified locations for new historical signage on South Street and planned a collaboration with Medford High School vocational students for the design and fabrication of the signs.

items.title: Homeowner Informational Mailer
items.summary: Members reviewed draft trifold mailers intended to inform residents about historic district regulations and grants, deciding to include a refrigerator magnet with a QR code for easy access to city resources.

items.title: 20 Hillside Avenue Awareness
items.summary: Theresa Dupont provided an update on the recent sale of a property within the Hillside Avenue historic district, noting that the new owners are aware of preservation requirements.

items.title: 41 Mystic Avenue Preservation
items.summary: The commission reviewed a demolition permit application for the 1750 Benjamin Hall house and discussed the feasibility of relocating the structure as an alternative to a contested local historic district designation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.
